hook.voice: Three ways to catch a hidden camera with the phone already in your hand.

scenes.voice: One. Turn off the lights and slowly pan your camera across the room. A lens throws back a tiny bright reflection.
scenes.stock_dynamic: dark room phone camera scanning glint

scenes.voice: Two. Put a fingertip on any mirror. If there is a gap between your finger and its reflection, it is normal glass.
Three. Let your phone do all of it at once. It already has four sensors that catch what your eyes miss.
